study type: Population-based retrospective cohort study using data linkage
cohort: The study included 719,311 liveborn, non-Indigenous Australian singleton births recorded in Western Australia from January 1, 1980, to December 31, 2010.
finding: Children born with reduced gestational age, birthweight, and birth length had persistently increased rates of infection-related hospital admissions up to 18 years of age.
followup_time: Up to 18 years after birth, death, or end of 2010
birth_weight: All liveborn singletons; birthweight categorized by 500g bands and analyzed using gestational age-specific and sex-specific Z scores.
gest_age: All liveborn singletons; gestational age assessed from last menstrual period and ultrasonography, analyzed in relation to 39-40 weeks.
